title: Deterministic restricted weight query count
statement: Let $n>0$ and let $a,b$ be positive natural numbers with $2a\le b$. For a restricted-weight input, define the deterministic restricted-weight query count to be the product of its outer count and inner count.
caveat: The outer and inner counts are not defined in the supplied descriptions.
